title: Armor True Legend 1: Kenkon Chapter
originalTitle: 鎧正伝１　サムライトルーパー　乾坤編（けんこんへん）
summary: A novelization of TV episodes 1-19. It follows the broad TV plot while rearranging battles, increasing conversation among the five heroes, and choosing older-sounding terms such as 'armor warriors' and 'protective garments' before the characters settle on 'under-gear'. The reviewer especially likes the added character exchanges.
